whenToUse: Text to be used as is, such as an invite link, coupon code, or install command.
Long text that's hard to select.
Long-press copying is a hassle on phones.
whenNotToUse: Text people will edit (show it in an input field).
The goal is sharing (use a share sheet).
Sensitive values (consider the risk of what's left on the clipboard).

alternatives.name: Icon Button
alternatives.reason: Just a copy icon when space is tight.

accessibility: Announce the result with role="status" and change the button text to "Copied".
If copying is blocked, say "Couldn't copy" so people can select it themselves.
The read-only input selects everything on focus, so it can be copied by hand.
After a moment it returns to its original state and can be pressed again.
